'''Magical Pokémon Journey: Pokémon Sleepover''' is the sixteenth monthly issue released by [[VIZ Media]] of the [[Magical Pokémon Journey]] manga created by [[Yumi Tsukirino]]. It contains the eighth and ninth bonus chapters of the manga. The chapters originally released in this book were later re-released as part of {{Vol|Magical Pokémon Journey|4}}.
==Blurb==
'''''Once A Upon A Dark Poké-Night...'''''

''All the Pokémon and their trainers decide to spend a fun-filled day playing hide-and-to-go-seek in a local park. But when Peanut hides in a cave, the day takes a turn for the worst!'' 

''Then, Almond invites all the Pokémon over for the best sleepover ever! Just don't let Almond tell his most scary stories, or else.....''

==Chapters==
* [[PPPB08|The Unbearable Suspense of Hide-and-Seek!]]
* [[PPPB09|The Unbearable Suspense of... THE GHOSTSTORY!!! (BOO!)]]

==Important events==
* The group play a game of hide-and-seek, during which [[Peanut]], {{MPJ|Pikachu}}, and {{MPJ|Clefairy}} get lost in a scary cave.
* [[Hazel]] and the Pokémon sleep over at [[Coconut]]'s house after hearing a scary ghost story told by [[Almond]]. Due to misunderstandings caused by the Pokémon being scared, they trash Coconut's bedroom.

==Trivia==
* In the Pokémon File at the end of this issue, which also appears in {{Vol|Magical Pokémon Journey|4}}, {{TP|Pistachio|Bulbasaur}} is identified with the nickname "Bulba". Despite this, she is never referred to with a nickname in the English translation by any characters in the regular manga pages.
